# Sirach Chapter 28 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 28 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**28:1** He-who-takes-vengeance will-find vengeance from-the-LORD, and his-sins he-will-keep-firmly-in-view.

**28:2** Forgive your-neighbor his-injustice, and then your-sins will-be-loosed when-you-pray.

**28:3** A-man-who-holds-anger toward a-man — and from-the-LORD he-seeks-healing?

**28:4** He-has-no-mercy upon a-man like-himself — and he-will-petition concerning his-own-sins?

**28:5** He himself [being] flesh keeps-hold-of wrath — who-will-make-atonement for-his-sins?

**28:6** Remember your-last-things and stop-the-hatred; [remember] corruption and death and remain-in-the-commandments.

**28:7** Remember the-commandments and do-not-be-angry with-your-neighbor, and [remember] the-covenant of-the-Most-High and overlook the-offense.

**28:8** Refrain-from-strife and you-will-diminish sins; for a-passionate-man kindles-strife,

**28:9** and a-man-who-is-a-sinner will-trouble-friends and will-cast enmity among those-who-are-at-peace.

**28:10** According-to the-fuel of-the-fire, so it-will-burn; and according-to the-obstinacy of-a-man the-strife will-be-great; and according-to his-strength the-wrath will-be-greater-still.

**28:11** A-hasty-quarrel kindles-fire, and a-hasty-dispute sheds-blood.

**28:12** If you-blow on a-spark, it-will-blaze-up; and if you-spit on-it, it-goes-out — and both-of-these come-from your-mouth.

**28:13** Curse the-whisperer and the-double-tongued, for he-has-destroyed many-who-were-at-peace.

**28:14** A-third tongue has-shaken-loose many and dispersed-them from-nation to-nation, and has-destroyed fortified-cities and overturned the-houses of-the-great.

**28:15** A-third tongue has-driven-out capable-wives and deprived-them of-the-fruit of-their-toils.

**28:16** Whoever-attends-to it will-find-no-rest, and will-not-dwell in-quietude.

**28:17** The-blow of a-whip leaves-a-bruise, but the-blow of a-tongue will-shatter-bones.

**28:18** Many-have-fallen by-the-edge of-the-sword, but not-as-many as have-fallen because-of the-tongue.

**28:19** Blessed is he-who-has-been-sheltered from it, who-has-not-passed-through its-fury; who-has-not-dragged its-yoke and-who-has-not-been-bound in-its-chains.

**28:20** For its-yoke is a-yoke of-iron and its-chains are-chains of-bronze.

**28:21** Its-death is an-evil-death, and Hades is-preferable to-it.

**28:22** It-will-have-no-power over the-devout, and they-will-not-be-burned in-its-flame.

**28:23** Those-who-abandon the-LORD will-fall-into it, and in-them it-will-burn and-not-be-quenched; it-will-be-sent-against-them like a-lion and-it-will-ravage-them like a-leopard.

**28:24** Fence-in your-properties with-thorns; your-silver and your-gold bind-fast.

**28:25** And for-your-mouth make a-door and a-bolt, and for-your-words a-balance and a-scale.

**28:26** Take-heed lest you-slip in-it, lest you-fall before-one-who-lies-in-wait for-you.
